result.summary: The page renders mostly well, but the 'Popular right now' section has an overlapping text defect in the restaurant metadata line, plus a couple of minor styling inconsistencies.

issues.description: In the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card, the metadata line shows overlapping text: '25–35 min' and '€0 delivery' are drawn on top of each other, making both strings illegible ('25–3 5 min€0 delivery').
issues.suggestion: Lay out the metadata items in a single flex row with proper spacing/separators instead of absolutely positioned or overlapping text nodes, and allow the row to wrap or truncate if space is limited.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use inconsistent styling — the first has a white/light circular background with a dark outline icon, while the second uses a dark circular background with a white icon.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background and icon colors across all cards, or use a consistent semi-transparent scrim that works on any image.

issues.description: The first card in 'Fastest near you' (Green Bowl Poké) has a light grey image background while the sibling cards have dark image backgrounds, making the row look visually uneven.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent image placeholder/background treatment (or uniform overlay gradient) to all carousel thumbnails.
